title: reaction.mass_balance_violation
description: M15D § Diagnostic event fired by cf-mod / cf-material registry loader when a reaction's input mass does not equal its output mass within the 0.01 g/mol tolerance. Used to reject broken mods and to surface registry-authoring mistakes. Per acceptance scenario 9: 'Given a mod ships content/reactions/custom_alchemy.ron with inputs_mass != outputs_mass / When cf-mod validation runs / Then reaction_mass_balance_violation fires with a diagnostic on stderr / And the mod's reaction is excluded / And the launch 55-reaction registry remains intact'.
